end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one group of ten and extra ones.
Saanvi worked with 13, 12, and 14 using bundle-and-loose-stick examples.
They mixed up the bundle as one object with its value of ten.
The mix-up remained at the end; teach-back was not completed.
Saanvi took a short water break and then resumed briefly.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers from one ten bundle and extra single sticks. The bundle-counting method was introduced, but they continued to count the bundle as one rather than ten; this was not corrected by the end. At home, use 10 objects tied together and add loose objects, asking, “How many altogether?”
